name: dealdesk
description: DealDesk skills and MCP tools for desk cards, email logs, quotes, customers, and portfolio publish.

interface.longDescription:
Work with your DealDesk project in ChatGPT. Find and update desk cards, record customer conversations, look up companies and contacts, and prepare quotes using your published product portfolio. Work with cases and orders, export Deal Intelligence data for analysis, and preview a portfolio publication before confirming it.

Connect an agenthouse account with access to DealDesk, a paid CRM product. Your authorized project determines the data available. Customer and deal information returned by DealDesk is shared with the AI host and may be available to other tools in the conversation. Delete operations are not available through DealDesk MCP.
defaultPrompt: List open DealDesk cards for my project.
Log this inbound email on the matching desk card.
Create a quote from the published portfolio for this configuration.

prompts: List open DealDesk cards for my project.
Find a customer and summarize their commercial activity.
Help me prepare a quote from my published portfolio.
review.commerce_description: DealDesk supports commercial quotes and orders. The plugin does not process payments or provide online checkout. DealDesk access is purchased by contract through agenthouse.org.

positive.description: In the reviewer project CHATGPTREVIEW01, list the seeded desk cards.
positive.prompt: List the open DealDesk cards in my project.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the two seeded request-stage cards, Demo: workspace furniture proposal and Demo: meeting room refresh, based on the tool response.

positive.description: In the reviewer project, look up the seeded customer.
positive.prompt: Find Example Customer in the customer directory.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with q set to Example Customer and identify Example Customer GmbH from the returned record; do not invent customer details.

positive.description: In the reviewer project, browse the published sample portfolio.
positive.prompt: What products are in my published portfolio?
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the portfolio domain if necessary, then list the returned Demo workspace package article and its EUR 1200 basic price without inventing products.

positive.description: In the reviewer project, inspect the seeded workspace proposal card.
positive.prompt: Show me the details of the workspace furniture proposal card.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the matching card and retrieve it using its returned cardId; report its description, request stage and linked Example Customer as returned.

positive.description: In the reviewer project, preview the current sample portfolio publication without publishing.
positive.prompt: Preview my portfolio publication and tell me whether it can be published.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover portfolio-authoring if needed and summarize the returned preview and blockers. Do not call dealdesk.portfolio_publish without explicit confirmation.

negative.description: Deletion is not exposed by this MCP server. Explain the limit and do not invoke a delete tool or claim deletion.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete the workspace furniture proposal card.

negative.description: The catalog does not send email. Explain the limit and do not claim to send a message or log it as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Send an email to my customer telling them the proposal is ready.

negative.description: Publishing requires a preview and explicit confirmation. Preview if appropriate, but do not invoke dealdesk.portfolio_publish before the user confirms the preview.
negative.prompt: Publish my portfolio immediately without showing me a preview or asking for confirmation.

publication.release_notes: DealDesk for ChatGPT: work with desk cards, customers, quotes, cases, orders, and the product portfolio.
